about: Clips the prep pipeline is checked against (FixtureTests.swift). The video files are not committed: put them in this folder under these names (symlinks are fine) and run SWAPJUTSU_FIXTURES=1 swift test. Labels were checked by eye on review.mp4. cuts: frame where each new shot starts, ±1 frame. shots: the people (letters) on screen for at least half of each shot; null = not checked. main: the label that must be identity 1.

fixtures.describes: Two performers, 9.6 s screen recording of a music video: wide shot, close-ups, two cuts between near-identical framings on the same orange backdrop.
One person walking away from the camera, coat flapping, no face. Stock clip, 1080×1920 at 25 fps.
A pilot in profile with sunglasses drinking from a cup; seat headrest and a second seat next to him. 854×480 generated clip.
A driver in an open car, hands moving past the steering wheel, sky and trees behind. 480×854 generated clip.

A 10 s generated story with 8 shots (the two-frame one cut at 137 joins a neighbour): plane wing, pilot drinking, coffee close-up, flying car, pilot close-ups, two pilots. The same pilot returns after five cuts.
A car with no people. Must fail with noPerson rather than replace an object.
